lanning Design Bid Construction Open to Public/Closeout 4/1/2002 4/1/2005 10/1/2005 4/1/2006 11/15/2006 10/7/2004 9/29/2005 1/13/2006 10/27/2006 3/1/2007 45 SF RPD - Capital Improvement Division Capital Plan - 2004 Annual Update BOS District 8 CHAPTER 2: 2004 IN REVIEW PROJECT TITLE: Buena Vista Park - Master Plan LOCATION: BUENA VISTA PARK PROJECT DIRECTOR: Marvin Yee STATUS: DISTRICT: On Hold PROJECT BACKGROUND/DESCRIPTION: Buena Vista Park, a 36-acre hilltop, was established as public open space in 1894. From 1936 to 1943, Franklin D. Roosevelt's Works Progress Administration (WPA) contributed to the park improvements, such as rock walls and formal entrances to the park. Tombstone fragments from former cemeteries in the vicinity, which have since moved to Colma, line the drainage gutter within the interior of the park. Buena Vista Park is essentially a remnant, inland sand dune. Years of neglected use, limited improvements and an aging forest canopy have contributed to severe erosion throughout this fragile environment. In 1989, the Department of Public Works prepared a master plan and an erosion control plan for Buena Vista Park. Several of the master plan elements have been implemented, including improvements to the tennis courts and the children's play area, and conversion of a parking lot to a grassy knoll at the summit. Despite much plantings and bio-engineered means of erosion control, Buena Vista Park is in need of significant capital improvements to adequately address these eroded areas.
